choose.when: SELECT DATE(create_time) as date, SUM(total_price) as totalAmount, COUNT(*) as orderCount FROM orders WHERE 1=1 AND products_user_id = #{userId} AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY date

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%u') as date, SUM(total_price) as totalAmount, COUNT(*) as orderCount FROM orders WHERE 1=1 AND products_user_id = #{userId} AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 4 WEEK) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%u') ORDER BY date

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') as date, SUM(total_price) as totalAmount, COUNT(*) as orderCount FROM orders WHERE 1=1 AND products_user_id = #{userId} AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY date

SELECT YEAR(create_time) as date, SUM(total_price) as totalAmount, COUNT(*) as orderCount FROM orders WHERE 1=1 AND products_user_id = #{userId} AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 2 YEAR) GROUP BY YEAR(create_time) ORDER BY date
choose.otherwise: SELECT DATE(create_time) as date, SUM(total_price) as totalAmount, COUNT(*) as orderCount FROM orders WHERE 1=1 AND products_user_id = #{userId} AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY date

mapper.select: SELECT p.products_id, p.name, SUM(op.quantity) as totalQuantity, SUM(op.price * op.quantity) as totalAmount FROM orders o INNER JOIN orders_products op ON o.orders_id = op.orders_id INNER JOIN products p ON op.products_id = p.products_id WHERE 1=1 AND o.products_user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY p.products_id, p.name ORDER BY totalAmount DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count FROM orders WHERE 1=1 AND products_user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY status

select o.orders_id, o.products_user_id, o.create_time, o.shipping_time, o.complete_time, o.total_price, o.name, o.phone, o.address, o.status, o.user_id, u.user_name, -- 下单用户 (select real_name from farmers where user_id = o.products_user_id) as farmersName -- 农户名称 from orders o left join sys_user u on o.user_id = u.user_id where o.user_id = #{userId} order by o.create_time desc
